scenarios.label: Recent de novo sweep (LCT-like), 5 kya, s = 0.1
scenarios.rationale: A single new copy 200 generations ago, still compressing coalescence at the moment of sampling, so the signal should sit below the onset. s = 0.1 rather than an LCT-textbook 0.05 because run7 measured 0.05 over 200 generations: mean final frequency 0.016. Published LCT estimates span roughly 0.01-0.19.

scenarios.label: De novo sweep at the pulse time, 55 kya, s = 0.002
scenarios.rationale: A single new copy on an ordinary modern background, starting when the pulse lands and under the same coefficient as the introgressed arm. Holding onset and s fixed leaves origin as the only difference, so the contrast measures what an archaic starting pool does and nothing else.

scenarios.label: Selected introgressed allele, 55 kya pulse, s = 0.002
scenarios.rationale: The allele arrives on archaic haplotypes at 2.5%. Carriers can only coalesce after the pulse or back in the archaic branch, so the signal is floored by the pulse and a more recent cutoff cannot capture it.

scenarios.label: Selected introgressed allele, 55 kya pulse, s = 0.001
scenarios.rationale: The 'or even lower?' bracket. Expected to end near 7%, which leaves few carrier-carrier pairs, so it tests where the approach runs out rather than where it works.

analysis.scored_at: focal allele position, per 10 kb stride
analysis.significance_rule: at most one of the neutral replicates may exceed the observation

conditioning.neutral_conditioning: none; the neutral mode carries no focal allele

decoding.note: theta/rho are pinned to the Gamma-SMC paper and are not derived from the simulation rates; the decoder never sees mu or r.
decoding.primary_statistic: frac_recent_<T> (proportion of posterior means below T)

pairs.selection: decoder random draw; truth evaluated on the same manifest
